sources.title: 210 ILCS 45, Nursing Home Care Act, Article III Part 4 — Discharge and Transfer
sources.source_date: sections carry their own Source lines; the newest is P.A. 104-191, eff. 1-1-26
sources.notes: The General Assembly's own print view, reached by plain curl with a browser user-agent; the URL's SeqStart and SeqEnd already narrow the served document to the range the page reads, and the slice cuts the site chrome above the Part 4 heading. No 'to' anchor: Part 4 runs to the end of the served document, so the slice runs to the end too, exactly as the standing packet holds it. The mid-sentence line breaks inside subsection text are the ILGA page's own markup, and each section's '(Source: P.A. ...)' line is the Assembly's own currency note.
